verdict.rationale:
Medusa documents a full headless Storefront REST API (OpenAPI spec confirmed in medusa-gh-x1), ships an official JS SDK (medusa-probe-rt-2 confirms it installs and works), provides storefront development guides and first-party Next.js/Gatsby starter kits (medusa-docs-5, medusa-comm-9), all backed by an open-source, customizable commerce framework (medusa-gh-1, medusa-gh-4). Community hands-on feedback corroborates real-world headless usage and maturity (medusa-comm-3, medusa-comm-9) though notes some feature gaps like i18n (medusa-comm-4).

missing for 10: a live public openapi.json endpoint (probe found 404s) and broader independent benchmarking of the storefront API's completeness beyond one HN thread.
